text_block_list.text:
I came to the cafeteria at lunchtime. Just 
as I was about to choose something from 
the menu—

Eishin Flash stared at the lined-up menu 
items with a grave expression on her face.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
It seems my usual order here is suddenly 
out of stock today due to ingredient 
availability...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Because of that, the dietary plan I had 
scheduled has fallen apart, and I am at a 
loss for how to handle it.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Revising the training menu from scratch 
now could cause significant delays to our 
upcoming schedule...
choice_data_list:
Since you're here, why not try something 
you've never eaten before?

text_block_list.text:
That way, we can formulate backup plans 
and handle unexpected situations like 
today's...

might turn out to be even more meaningful.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Thank you very much for your advice.
